lines.zh: 我摆动尾巴，鳄形的身子贴着水面走。
lines.en: I sweep my tail and my crocodile body skims the surface.

lines.zh: 我的吻部切开水面，留下一道路。
lines.en: My snout cuts the water and leaves a wake.

lines.zh: 鳍和腿一起划，两岸的泥我都熟。
lines.en: Fins and legs row together; I know both muddy banks.

lines.zh: 我沿河口慢慢巡，鳞甲上挂着小草。
lines.en: I patrol the river mouth slowly, weed on my scales.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴比鳍好用，一扫就出去两丈。
lines.en: My tail beats my fins; one sweep carries me far.

lines.zh: 浅滩的水只到我背，我照样游得动。
lines.en: The shallows reach my back and I still swim fine.

lines.zh: 我贴着泥底走，泥就翻起来一片。
lines.en: I skim the mud bottom and it churns up behind me.

lines.zh: 水路我走了很多遍，闭眼也认得。
lines.en: I have swum this way so often I know it blind.

lines.zh: 我从深水游到浅水，慢慢换了步调。
lines.en: I move from deep to shallow and change my pace.

lines.zh: 鳄形的身体不好转身，我索性直着走。
lines.en: This crocodile body turns poorly, so I go straight.

lines.zh: 我浮上来换气，鼻孔先露出来。
lines.en: I surface to breathe, nostrils breaking the water first.

lines.zh: 河口的咸淡交界，是我最爱走的地方。
lines.en: The brackish line of the river mouth is my favorite path.

lines.zh: 我游过水草，草叶被鳞甲刮得直响。
lines.en: I pass the reeds and they rasp against my scales.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍一摆，泥底的螺壳都翻了。
lines.en: My tail sweeps and snail shells turn over in the mud.

lines.zh: 我把吻部抬出水面，闻一闻岸上。
lines.en: I lift my snout out of the water and sniff the bank.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，我从浅滩滑进深水。
lines.en: One flick of the tail, and I slide off the shallows into deep water.

lines.zh: 水草缠了一下，我抖开继续走。
lines.en: Weeds snag me for a moment; I shake loose and keep going.

lines.zh: 我沿岸线巡，不急，也不停。
lines.en: I patrol the shoreline, unhurried and never stopping.

lines.zh: 我浮在水面，只把眼睛和鼻孔露出来。
lines.en: I float with only my eyes and nostrils showing.

lines.zh: 我趴在浅滩上，像一根烂木头。
lines.en: I lie on the shallows like a rotting log.

lines.zh: 我的鳞甲晒得发干，我也不动。
lines.en: My scales dry in the sun and I do not move.

lines.zh: 一只鹭落在不远处，我们各等各的。
lines.en: A heron lands nearby and we wait on our own.

lines.zh: 我把吻部搁在泥上，听水下的动静。
lines.en: I rest my snout in the mud and listen below.

lines.zh: 水面起了细纹，是鱼在下面换气。
lines.en: Fine rings spread on the water; fish are breathing below.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，连尾巴都懒得摆。
lines.en: I stay still, too lazy even to swing my tail.

lines.zh: 泥味、水味、血腥味，我分得很清。
lines.en: Mud, water, blood: I can tell them apart.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛露出水面，像两颗湿钉子。
lines.en: My eyes sit above the water like two wet nails.

lines.zh: 太阳把我的背晒热，我就更不想走。
lines.en: The sun warms my back and I want to move less.

lines.zh: 潜伏这件事，我比海里的谁都做得好。
lines.en: At lying in wait, I am better than anything in the sea.

lines.zh: 水面很平，我的呼吸只弄出一点泡。
lines.en: The surface is flat; my breath makes only a few bubbles.

lines.zh: 我等的那条鱼，还没游到浅处。
lines.en: The fish I wait for has not come shallow yet.

lines.zh: 这样趴一天，我也不觉得长。
lines.en: A whole day lying like this does not feel long.

lines.zh: 你走到岸边，我的鼻孔先动了。
lines.en: You reach the bank and my nostrils twitch first.

lines.zh: 我转过头，鳄形的吻对着你的膝盖。
lines.en: I turn, my crocodile snout level with your knees.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在水上，我盯着那片暗。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the water and I watch the dark.

lines.zh: 我在水里看你，眼睛只露出一点。
lines.en: I watch you from the water, eyes barely showing.

lines.zh: 你手里的斧头，我认得那种反光。
lines.en: I know that glint on the axe in your hand.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，不是示好，是在对焦。
lines.en: I blink slowly, not in greeting, but to focus.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来洗手，我数着你的手指。
lines.en: You crouch to wash your hands; I count your fingers.

lines.zh: 我停在你的下游，水把味道送过来。
lines.en: I hold downstream and the water brings your scent.

lines.zh: 你看我像块木头，我看你像顿晚饭。
lines.en: You see a log; I see an evening meal.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不转，身体却已经对准你。
lines.en: My eyes do not turn, but my body has lined up.

lines.zh: 鳞甲裂了一角，疼在里层。
lines.en: A corner of my scale plate splits and the pain is deep.

lines.zh: 我翻进水里，泥都溅到岸上。
lines.en: I roll into the water and mud splashes up the bank.

lines.zh: 我咬住疼，牙关一直没松。
lines.en: I bite down on the pain and do not open my jaws.

lines.zh: 谁砍的，我闻得出那股手汗。
lines.en: I can smell the hand sweat of whoever cut me.

lines.zh: 血混进泥里，我游得更急了。
lines.en: Blood mixes with the mud and I swim harder.

lines.zh: 这一下没伤到骨头，只伤了鳞。
lines.en: The blow misses bone and only breaks scales.

lines.zh: 我退了半条河，回头看了一眼。
lines.en: I retreat half a river and look back once.

lines.zh: 痛让我明白，你不是猎物。
lines.en: The pain tells me you are not prey.

lines.zh: 我浮上来喘，鳃一张一合地抖。
lines.en: I surface to breathe, gills shaking with each beat.

lines.zh: 老鳞挡了半下，也够了。
lines.en: My old scales take half the blow, which is enough.

lines.zh: 你扔下的生肉，在水里翻了个身。
lines.en: The raw meat you toss rolls over in the water.

lines.zh: 腐肉也行，我对味道不挑。
lines.en: Rotten flesh will do; I am not picky about smell.

lines.zh: 你把鱼挂在钩上，那钩我看得见。
lines.en: You hang a fish on a hook, and I see the hook.

lines.zh: 血腥味一散开，我就把头压低。
lines.en: The smell of blood spreads and I lower my head.

lines.zh: 我靠近那块肉，尾巴先摆了两下。
lines.en: I near the meat, tail swinging twice first.

lines.zh: 诱饵放得太浅，我在深处看着。
lines.en: The bait sits too shallow; I watch from deeper water.

lines.zh: 我不扑，我先绕半圈再靠近。
lines.en: I do not lunge; I circle halfway before closing in.

lines.zh: 那点肉不够我一口，但我还是要。
lines.en: That scrap is not a mouthful, but I want it.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我才肯上前吃。
lines.en: Only when you step back will I come and eat.

lines.zh: 我张嘴咬住肉，水花只溅了一点。
lines.en: I take the meat and barely splash.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的鳞甲，硬得像石头。
lines.en: You hit my scales; they are hard as stone.

lines.zh: 我被顶得歪了一下，尾巴扫起泥。
lines.en: I lurch sideways and my tail stirs the mud.

lines.zh: 别踩我的尾巴，那是我的桨。
lines.en: Do not step on my tail; it is my paddle.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我一口牙先张开了。
lines.en: You ram me and my teeth are already bared.

lines.zh: 我的皮很粗，蹭过你的胳膊会留印。
lines.en: My hide is rough and will scrape your arm.

lines.zh: 我让开半尺，泥里多了一个坑。
lines.en: I give half a foot and leave a pit in the mud.

lines.zh: 水被我们搅浑，谁也看不清谁。
lines.en: We muddy the water until neither can see.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被碰，尤其是背上的老鳞。
lines.en: I dislike being touched, especially my old back scales.

lines.zh: 你手一推，我的爪子抓紧了泥。
lines.en: You shove and my claws grip the mud.

lines.zh: 撞完你退开，我还站在原地看你。
lines.en: You back off after the bump and I keep watching.

lines.zh: 我们并排浮着，只露出四只眼睛。
lines.en: We float side by side, showing four eyes.

lines.zh: 我用吻部碰她的颈，她没有躲。
lines.en: I nudge her neck with my snout and she stays.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴在水下同步，泥都静了。
lines.en: Two tails beat together underwater and the mud settles.

lines.zh: 我们在同一片浅滩上晒太阳。
lines.en: We sun ourselves on the same shallow bank.

lines.zh: 她把头搁在我背上，鳞碰着鳞。
lines.en: She rests her head on my back, scale against scale.

lines.zh: 我衔来一根水草，放在她面前。
lines.en: I carry a reed over and lay it before her.

lines.zh: 河口的泥是我们一起选的巢。
lines.en: The mud of the river mouth is the nest we chose.

lines.zh: 她比我短一截，可咬起东西更狠。
lines.en: She is shorter than I am but bites harder.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此转，水纹一圈一圈。
lines.en: We circle each other and the ripples go round.

lines.zh: 别的鳄形同类，我们也不许靠近。
lines.en: We let no other axodile come near us.

lines.zh: 我只有爪子，抓得动泥，抓不住小物。
lines.en: My claws grip mud but cannot hold small things.

lines.zh: 你掉下的斧鳄皮，我看着它沉了。
lines.en: The axoleather you drop, I watch it sink.

lines.zh: 我用吻部推了推，它滚进泥缝里。
lines.en: I nudge it with my snout and it rolls into the mud.

lines.zh: 地上那块骨头，我只咬了一口。
lines.en: I take one bite of the bone on the ground.

lines.zh: 我没有口袋，尾巴也夹不住东西。
lines.en: I have no pockets and my tail holds nothing.

lines.zh: 沉在河底的东西，我从来不捡。
lines.en: I never pick up what sinks to the riverbed.

lines.zh: 那块铁在水里发暗，我没兴趣。
lines.en: That iron darkens in the water; I am not interested.

lines.zh: 你想让我叼回来，我可没这么听话。
lines.en: You want me to fetch it; I am not that obedient.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，又合上了，什么也没拿。
lines.en: I open my mouth, close it, and take nothing.

lines.zh: 水底的东西归水底，这是规矩。
lines.en: What lies on the bottom stays there; that is the rule.

lines.zh: 你踩进浅水，泥一响，我就抬头了。
lines.en: You step into the shallows; the mud sounds and I look up.

lines.zh: 我挑离水最近的猎物，退路最短。
lines.en: I pick the prey nearest the water, with the shortest retreat.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼在挣，我盯的是你的手。
lines.en: Your fish is struggling, but I watch your hand.

lines.zh: 我在你下游沉下去，只剩眼睛在水面。
lines.en: I sink downstream of you with only my eyes showing.

lines.zh: 猎物越小，我越有把握。
lines.en: The smaller the prey, the more certain I am.

lines.zh: 我的鼻孔一张，就把你的味道记住了。
lines.en: My nostrils flare and I have your scent for good.

lines.zh: 那条大鱼受伤了，我先盯它。
lines.en: That big fish is wounded; I take it first.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把身体摆成一条直线。
lines.en: I slowly line my body up straight.

lines.zh: 你回头看了我一眼，已经晚了。
lines.en: You glance back at me, and it is already too late.

lines.zh: 我把吻部沉进水里，只留尾尖动。
lines.en: I sink my snout and let only my tail tip move.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚印，脚印在水里散开。
lines.en: I follow your footprints; they dissolve in the water.

lines.zh: 你往岸上跑，我在水里跟得比你快。
lines.en: You run for the bank, and I keep pace faster.

lines.zh: 我绕到浅滩那头，堵住你的路。
lines.en: I swing to the far shallows and cut you off.

lines.zh: 你越慌，泥就越是把你的脚拖住。
lines.en: The more you panic, the more the mud holds your feet.

lines.zh: 我不急，河水会把你送到我这。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the current brings you to me.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直露着，你甩不掉。
lines.en: My eyes stay above water and you cannot lose me.

lines.zh: 你踩水的声音，我隔着十里也听得见。
lines.en: I hear your splashing from far downstream.

lines.zh: 我从你身后浮起来，水面只起一点纹。
lines.en: I rise behind you with only a ripple.

lines.zh: 这条路只通向深水，你在往里走。
lines.en: This way leads only to deep water, and you are going in.

lines.zh: 我等你踩进我埋身的那片泥。
lines.en: I wait for you to step into the mud hiding me.

lines.zh: 我侧头一咬，牙就扣进你的腿。
lines.en: I snap sideways and my teeth lock into your leg.

lines.zh: 泥水翻起来，我们滚进了浅滩。
lines.en: The mud churns and we roll into the shallows.

lines.zh: 我咬住就往下拖，水会替我出力。
lines.en: I bite and drag down; the water does the rest.

lines.zh: 我的牙参差不齐，咬合却不松。
lines.en: My teeth are uneven, but my grip does not slip.

lines.zh: 你别挣，越挣我咬得越深。
lines.en: Do not struggle; the more you do, the deeper I bite.

lines.zh: 这一口之后，水里全是铁味。
lines.en: After that bite the water tastes of iron.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一卷，把你的脚扫倒了。
lines.en: My tail sweeps your feet out from under you.

lines.zh: 我不是猎手，我是等在泥里的钳子。
lines.en: I am no hunter; I am a clamp waiting in the mud.

lines.zh: 你退到岸上，我才松开嘴。
lines.en: Only when you are on the bank do I let go.

lines.zh: 这颗牙掉了没关系，我还有一排。
lines.en: Losing that tooth is fine; I have a row left.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋落在浅滩，我从泥里爬出来。
lines.en: The egg drops in the shallows and I crawl out of mud.

lines.zh: 我先学会浮水，再学会埋伏。
lines.en: I learn to float before I learn to ambush.

lines.zh: 河口的水半咸半淡，正合我。
lines.en: The river mouth is half salt, half fresh, as I like it.

lines.zh: 我出生时尾巴比身体还长。
lines.en: When I am born my tail is longer than my body.

lines.zh: 主世界的河岸是我第一片领地。
lines.en: The Overworld riverbank is my first ground.

lines.zh: 我的鳞甲一开始是软的，后来才硬。
lines.en: My scales start soft and harden only later.

lines.zh: 我睁眼就看见水面上的光。
lines.en: I open my eyes and see light on the water.

lines.zh: 泥把我托起来，我就有了重量。
lines.en: The mud lifts me and I take on weight.

lines.zh: 群系的水温决定我在哪片浅滩落脚。
lines.en: The biome's water decides which bank I claim.

lines.zh: 更大的同类会来，我得先长大。
lines.en: The Greater Axodiles will come; I must grow first.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我的鳞烫得发白。
lines.en: Fire burns on the water and my scales pale with heat.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，尾巴先砸进浅滩。
lines.en: I fall from a height, tail hitting the shallows first.

lines.zh: 水里有的是氧，我却吸不到。
lines.en: There is air in the water, yet I cannot draw it.

lines.zh: 一股气浪把我掀出水面。
lines.en: A shockwave throws me clear of the surface.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我的鳞缝，卡得很深。
lines.en: An arrow lodges deep between my scales.

lines.zh: 药水味顺着鳃爬进来，我发晕。
lines.en: Potion reek crawls in through my gills and I reel.

lines.zh: 河口的鱼少了，我开始咬水草。
lines.en: Fish thin out at the mouth and I start biting reeds.

lines.zh: 雷击在河面，我的尾巴先麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the river and my tail goes numb first.

lines.zh: 我掉出世界，连泥水都没有了。
lines.en: I fall out of the world where even mud is gone.
